reasoning: jsonwebtoken@0.1.0 is a transitive dependency pulled in by express-jwt@0.1.3, which contains vulnerability GHSA-c7hr-j4mj-j2w6. The issue is fixed in jsonwebtoken@4.2.2. Because express-jwt mandates ~0.1.0 for jsonwebtoken, updating express-jwt directly or running standard npm update will not upgrade jsonwebtoken to a patched version. Configuring an npm override for jsonwebtoken to 4.2.2 ensures all transitive usages are pinned to a secure version while preserving application structure.
